cds.title: Arkansas Tech University Common Data Set 2025-2026 (PDF, ATU Institutional Research 'CDS_fall_2025')

stats.notes: CDS C1 (Fall 2025): residency rows (in-state / out-of-state / international / unknown) sum to the totals (3,797 applied, 3,701 admitted, 1,225 enrolled). Only 7 first-year international applicants (6 admitted, 6 enrolled) in this CDS, so the international admit rate is not meaningful. C9: 3.00% (33 students) submitted SAT and 87.00% (1,067) submitted ACT. The SAT composite row (25th/50th/75th = 900/900/1160) looks like a data-entry slip (50th equals 25th), so SAT_TOTAL is omitted. The PDF stores text in an unreadable font encoding; numbers were read by page coordinates and cross-checked (GPA bands sum to 99.99%). C7 factor checkboxes could not be read, so 'factors' is omitted. Undergraduate enrollment is the B1 'Total Undergraduates' figure (8,279; 5,277 degree-seeking, the rest mostly non-degree/dual-credit); intl_undergrads is the B2 nonresident total (93).
